answer.text:
At this price point (under ₹2,500), "7.1 surround sound" is **virtual 7.1** enabled via a USB sound card or PC software, rather than physical multi-driver hardware. 

The top gaming headsets featuring 7.1 surround sound under ₹2,500 include:

| Model | Core Specs | Surround Tech | Best For | Price |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **EKSA E900 Pro** | 50mm drivers, detachable mic, USB + 3.5mm dual input | Hardware/Software 7.1 Virtual | **Best Overall** (Versatility & build quality) | ~₹2,200 - ₹2,499 |
| **Redgear Cosmo 7.1** | 50mm drivers, built-in USB sound card, RGB, inline control | Hardware USB 7.1 Virtual | **PC Gamers** who want heavy bass and RGB | ~₹1,800 - ₹2,100 |
| **Cosmic Byte Equinox Europa** | Dual-input (USB + 3.5mm), ENC Mic, EQ software support | Software 7.1 Virtual (via USB) | **Multi-Platform** (PC + Mobile/Consoles) | ~₹2,200 - ₹2,499 |
| **Ant Esports H707 / H1100 Pro** | 50mm drivers, USB interface, RGB lighting | Hardware USB 7.1 Virtual | **Budget Buyers** looking for lower price points | ~₹1,000 - ₹1,400 |

---

**Key Recommendations:**

* **Go with the EKSA E900 Pro** if you want the best balance of surround sound positional audio, comfort, and build durability. The detachable cable lets you switch between PC (USB for 7.1) and consoles/mobile (3.5mm jack).
* **Go with the Redgear Cosmo 7.1** if you play exclusively on PC, prefer a dedicated USB connection, and want strong bass with a flashy design.

*(Note: Virtual 7.1 features typically require a USB connection and only function on PC. When connected via a standard 3.5mm audio jack, headsets default to stereo.)*
